title: New checkout for the Hartwell demo
transcript:
[00:00] Leila: Hartwell Outdoor confirmed the demo for Thursday the 12th. Their CFO is joining.
[00:06] Sam: Is this about the one-page checkout?
[00:10] Leila: Yes. It's the main reason they're looking at us. Their current checkout is five steps.
[00:17] Ottilie: The one-page flow works on my branch. Card and wallet payments both go through in test mode.
[00:25] Sam: Tax calculation is still the old service, though. It's slow on the first call.
[00:31] Ottilie: I can warm it before the demo.
[00:35] Leila: Then let's have the new checkout ready for the Hartwell demo. Ottilie owns it, Sam helps with tax.
[00:43] Ottilie: Ready for the twelfth, got it.
[00:47] Sam: Sure, I'll look at caching the tax rates.
[00:51] Leila: I'll send them the agenda tomorrow. Thirty minutes, checkout first.
[00:56] Sam: Do we show the admin side too?
[01:00] Leila: Only if they ask. Keep it on the buyer flow.
[01:05] Ottilie: Makes sense.
[01:09] Leila: Thanks, everyone.
